title: templates/.gitignore: ignorar cam-worker-out e cam-plan-out logs (downstream)
description: Projetos criados por cam init copiam templates/.gitignore como seed. Downstream roda cam next (escreve .claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log) e cam plan (runPlanPhase escreve .claude/cam-plan-out-{planner,auditor}-<uuid>.log). templates/.gitignore NAO ignora nenhum dos dois padroes, entao projetos downstream sofrem o mesmo clean-tree false-halt que CAM-158 corrige apenas no .gitignore do repo-root do cam-cli. CAM-158 US-001 foi deliberadamente escopado so pro repo-root (auditor F-02). FIX: adicionar .claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log E .claude/cam-plan-out-*.log ao templates/.gitignore; rodar embed-vendor:check pois templates/ e embedado no binario. P3. Achado pelo auditor no plan-audit do CAM-158.

acceptanceCriteria: templates/.gitignore contains the exact glob line `.claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log`.
templates/.gitignore contains the exact glob line `.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log`.
Only those two lines are added to templates/.gitignore (surgical): no other pattern in templates/.gitignore is added, removed, or reordered.
The embedded copy is regenerated: `bun run embed-vendor` is run and the updated src/templates/embedded.ts is committed so `bun run embed-vendor:check` exits 0.
Full quality spine is green on the branch: `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bun run check:all`, and `bun run embed-vendor:check` all pass.
spec.scope: Add exactly two ignore patterns (`.claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log` and `.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log`) to templates/.gitignore so that cam-init-seeded downstream projects ignore the per-invocation worker-out and plan-out logs and no longer hit the clean-tree false-halt that CAM-158 fixed only in the cam-cli repo-root .gitignore. Regenerate the embedded templates copy via embed-vendor. OUT OF SCOPE: reconciling any other drift between templates/.gitignore and the repo-root .gitignore; touching the repo-root .gitignore (already fixed in CAM-158); changing the log filename patterns themselves.
gotchas: templates/ is embedded into the binary by scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts -> src/templates/embedded.ts. Any edit to templates/.gitignore MUST be followed by `bun run embed-vendor` and the regenerated src/templates/embedded.ts committed, or the `embed-vendor:check` quality gate fails.
Mirror the exact glob patterns from the repo-root .gitignore lines 57/59 (`.claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log`, `.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log`) — globs, not literal per-invocation filenames.
CAM-158 US-001 was deliberately scoped to the repo-root .gitignore only (auditor finding F-02); CAM-160 is the templates/ mirror. Do NOT re-touch the repo-root .gitignore.
Place the two lines coherently next to the existing CAM-68 `.claude/.cam-*` marker block already present in templates/.gitignore.
